SELLER_STEPS.title: Get your valuation
SELLER_STEPS.desc: Enter your reg and details for a free, instant estimate.

SELLER_STEPS.title: Go live in auction
SELLER_STEPS.desc: Your car goes live for verified dealers to view and bid on.

SELLER_STEPS.title: Dealers compete
SELLER_STEPS.desc: Verified trade buyers bid against each other, not against you.

SELLER_STEPS.title: Dealer contacts you
SELLER_STEPS.desc: The winning dealer arranges collection and inspection directly.

SELLER_STEPS.title: Dealer pays you directly
SELLER_STEPS.desc: The money moves dealer → you. CarMazium is never in that chain.

SELLER_STEPS.title: Get your £100 reward
SELLER_STEPS.desc: After you confirm payment and your handover photo is approved, qualifying auction sales earn a £100 reward.

DEALER_STEPS.title: Search & find
DEALER_STEPS.desc: Filter by make, model, grade and location to shortlist cars.

DEALER_STEPS.title: Join the auction
DEALER_STEPS.desc: Only verified motor traders with bidding access can bid live in the dealer auction.

DEALER_STEPS.title: Win the auction
DEALER_STEPS.desc: Highest bid when the clock runs out takes the car.

DEALER_STEPS.title: Complete checkout
DEALER_STEPS.desc: Pay the one-off buyer fee that unlocks the seller's contact details.

DEALER_STEPS.title: Arrange collection
DEALER_STEPS.desc: Coordinate inspection and collection directly with the seller.

DEALER_STEPS.title: Drive with confidence
DEALER_STEPS.desc: Inspect, complete the handover, and it's yours.

rows.note: paid to you, by the dealer

SELLER_STEPS.title: List for free.
SELLER_STEPS.desc: Add your vehicle details, photos and known damage. Motor vehicles use the registration-assisted form. Touring caravans use manual details, need at least one photo and do not require registration, VIN, mileage or year; you choose your price without an automated valuation.

SELLER_STEPS.title: Set your reserve.
SELLER_STEPS.desc: This is the minimum you're willing to accept. It's never shown to bidders — only you know it.

SELLER_STEPS.title: Go live for 24 hours.
SELLER_STEPS.desc: Your auction runs for a full 24-hour window, with real-time bidding from verified trade dealers.

SELLER_STEPS.title: Anti-snipe protection.
SELLER_STEPS.desc: Any bid placed in the final 3 minutes automatically extends the auction by 3 more minutes — so a last-second bid can't end things before you've had a fair chance to respond.

SELLER_STEPS.title: Auction ends.
SELLER_STEPS.desc: If your reserve is met, the winning dealer is notified. In-app chat with them opens once they've paid the £125 buyer fee, or straight away if a fee waiver applies.

SELLER_STEPS.title: Arrange handover.
SELLER_STEPS.desc: Agree the final details and handover directly with the buyer, then submit proof once it's done.

SELLER_STEPS.title: Get paid — plus £100.
SELLER_STEPS.desc: Once your handover proof is approved, CarMazium pays your £100 seller bonus directly to your account.

BUYER_STEPS.title: Get verified.
BUYER_STEPS.desc: Apply for a Dealer account and complete our KYC check.

BUYER_STEPS.title: Browse live and upcoming auctions.
BUYER_STEPS.desc: Filter by make, model, condition grade, and more.

BUYER_STEPS.title: Check the vehicle.
BUYER_STEPS.desc: Review the seller’s photos, description and disclosures. Motor vehicles show available official history; touring caravans use seller-supplied information without DVLA/MOT history or a car-shaped damage model.

BUYER_STEPS.title: Bid in real time,
BUYER_STEPS.desc: or use Buy It Now if the seller has set one for an instant win.

BUYER_STEPS.title: Win the auction.
BUYER_STEPS.desc: Highest bid wins, provided the seller's reserve is met.

BUYER_STEPS.title: Pay the buyer fee, if applicable.
BUYER_STEPS.desc: After winning, pay the one-off £125 buyer fee unless your account has an approved fee waiver. Paying the fee, or an eligible waiver, unlocks in-app chat with the seller to arrange handover. The fee is separate from the vehicle price.

RULES.def: Auctions start with a 24-hour window. Late bids can extend the end time under the anti-snipe rule.
A bid in the last 3 minutes extends the auction by 3 minutes — repeats until bidding settles.
Set privately by the seller. If it isn't met, there's no sale and nothing is owed by anyone.
Optional — sellers can set an instant-buy price. Buyers can request it; the seller has 24 hours to confirm or decline.
Listing a car for auction costs nothing.
Paid once CarMazium approves your submitted handover proof.
Charged on auction wins unless an approved fee waiver applies. Payment or a waiver unlocks seller chat.
Every bidder is a KYC-verified trade dealer.

TRUST.title: Automatic condition grading (1–5)
TRUST.desc: Computed from the damage you report, not self-selected.

TRUST.title: Condition & damage information
TRUST.desc: Review seller photographs and disclosures before bidding. Touring caravans use photographs instead of a car-shaped 3D damage model.

TRUST.title: Vehicle history where available
TRUST.desc: Motor-vehicle listings show available official MOT and registration information. Touring caravan details are supplied manually by the seller.

FAQS.q: Do I need to be a dealer to bid?
FAQS.a: Yes — bidding is limited to verified dealer accounts. Anyone can list and sell a car, though.

FAQS.q: What happens if my reserve isn't met?
FAQS.a: No sale happens, no fees are charged, and you're free to relist.

FAQS.q: When do I actually get my £100?
FAQS.a: After you submit proof of handover and CarMazium's team approves it.

The standard fee is £125 after an auction win, unless your account has an approved waiver. Paying it, or having an eligible waiver, unlocks in-app chat with the seller for handover. The vehicle price is settled directly between buyer and seller.

FAQS.q: Does CarMazium handle payment for the car itself?
FAQS.a: No. The vehicle sale is agreed and completed directly between you and the buyer — CarMazium isn't a party to that payment. CarMazium's role covers the auction, verification, the seller bonus, and the buyer connection fee.
